The '''Mon Calamari Commercial Expeditionary Service''' was a venture of [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] trading service developed by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. [[Mon Calamari Shipyards/Legends|Mon Calamari Shipyards]] provided the Commercial Expeditionary Service with [[Starship/Legends|ships]], including [[DeepWater-class light freighter|''DeepWater''-class light freighters]]. This submersible [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] was the suggested backbone for the whole Commercial Expeditionary Service's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] and around 10,000 ''DeepWaters'' were built.<ref name="Stock Ships" />

At some point the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] ordered the Mon Calamari Commercial Expeditionary Service to be dissolved without a warning. The fleet of ships owned by the Commercial Expeditionary Service were placed into auction, where private citizens could purchase them.<ref name="Stock Ships" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mon Calamari Commercial Expeditionary Service was mentioned in [[West End Games]]' [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[Stock Ships]]'', published in [[1997]].
